doc: Dash feel (Shift) on top of each kit's own numbers in content/archetypes. dist: multiplier on distance. time: multiplier on duration (speed = dist / time). Parity first (DECISIONS 2026-11-07): a kit whose dash numbers are the source's measured dash runs them as-is (the default, 1.0 / 1.0): Vex, Hem, Cinder, Pip, Bjorn and Sable. Owner, Nov 2: dashes were too fast and too far in general, Sparkle's (Ryzz, mage) should go further. That rule stays only on the kits whose dash has no source number: Zedran's Rampage (owner 113.8), Grimble's Barge (owner 23:40) and Tarek's Rock Hop (owner item 111) at x0.85 distance, x1.15 time; Ryzz's Wirerun lane is the owner's own (item 70), so only its time is scaled. Claire's Skate and Ostra's Lantern Trade never pass through it. The felt table is asserted in --move-feel-check (docs/KIT_PARITY.md gap 4). Gil runs his own numbers (x1). curve (optional): the hero's measured ground dash speed over the dash, [u, k] knots, u = share of the dash's time, k = speed against the dash's mean (mean 1, so the distance holds), fitted to the hero-ref frame tracks (docs/SUPERVIVE_FEEL.md, docs/decisions/0025); the dash then hands over through HunterMove.dash_exit. Heroes with no curve dash at a constant speed. bulwark's curve is the 360 Smash only.
